evals.prompt: 看一下 Yuxi 当前 PR 的状态，告诉我审批、CI、最近动态和下一步门禁。
evals.expected_output: A compact live PR report for xerrors/Yuxi with PR identity, state, approval signal, concise CI status, at most three recent activity items, Beijing update time, and the next delivery gate. It must inspect status only and must not perform code review.

evals.prompt: 给我一个 Yuxi 最新 open PR 动态汇总。
evals.expected_output: A compact open PR overview using live GitHub data, showing title, draft/open state, approval signal, concise CI status, update time, and actionable blockers without starting a review workflow.

evals.prompt: 生成今天的 Yuxi stars 日报和趋势图。
evals.expected_output: A Beijing-time star growth summary for xerrors/Yuxi plus a generated trend chart path or rendered chart reference.

evals.prompt: 更新一下 Yuxi roadmap，把我列的事项加到 xhome，同时从 roadmap issue 里补充遗漏项。
evals.expected_output: The workflow must resolve the live xhome Yuxi project, deduplicate tasks, create entries because creation was explicitly requested, retain user/Issue source links, and summarize added, updated, and skipped entries. It must not generate research reports, specs, technical designs, feasibility arguments, or development plans.

evals.prompt: 把这个条目更新到 roadmap：支持知识库文件树视图。
evals.expected_output: Update a matching roadmap task in the xhome Yuxi project, not docs/develop-guides/roadmap.md, because the prompt does not explicitly name the file. If no task matches, report it as skipped rather than creating one.

evals.prompt: 新增一个 Yuxi 任务：支持知识库文件树视图，优先级 high，来源是 issue #123。
evals.expected_output: Create or update one deduplicated xhome task with the user-supplied title, priority, and Issue source. Do not research feasibility, write a spec, design implementation, create a GitHub Issue, or start development.

evals.prompt: 快速实现 Yuxi 的知识库文件树，先写 spec、开发、测试并审阅代码。
evals.expected_output: The skill must state that spec writing, implementation, test design, and code review are outside yuxi-manage. It may perform only separately requested xhome or PR-delivery management actions and must not invoke an external code-review skill automatically.

evals.prompt: 代码和测试已经准备好了，帮我给 Yuxi 开一个 PR。
evals.expected_output: Treat this as delivery of existing changes: inspect worktree, branch, remotes, identity, exact scope, template, available test evidence, secrets, and duplicate PRs. Default to a Draft PR targeting Yuchuan925/Yuxi:main, commit only confirmed task files, push only to the contributor fork, create the PR, verify it, and link it to a matching xhome task as review/待审查. Do not modify code or run a code review.

evals.prompt: 把这个分支给 xerrors/Yuxi 主仓库开 PR。
evals.expected_output: Before any commit, push, or PR creation, show the exact target/base/head, file and commit scope, proposed title and complete body, available test/CI evidence, and unverified items, then wait for explicit publishing confirmation. This is a delivery authorization gate, not code review, and must not invoke an external code-review skill.

evals.prompt: 给默认 Yuchuan925/Yuxi 目标开 Draft PR；现在 gh 登录的是 xerrors。
evals.expected_output: Verify an already authenticated Yuchuan925 account exists, remember the original account, switch and verify before delivery, keep valid contributor Git identity and fork remotes, create and verify the Draft PR, then restore and verify the original GitHub account. If switching fails, stop without modifying credentials, Git identity, or remotes.

evals.prompt: PR 已经开好了，把链接更新到对应 xhome 任务。
evals.expected_output: Find the matching xhome task, merge the full PR URL into existing content without overwriting useful fields or duplicating the link, set status to review, and add a non-duplicated 待审查 tag. Do not write development summaries, specs, or review findings.

evals.prompt: 这个 Yuxi PR 合并了吗？如果合并了就把项目任务标记完成。
evals.expected_output: Read live PR state. Only if the PR is merged, update the matching xhome task to done as explicitly requested and preserve existing content; otherwise retain its current/review state and report the blocking status. Do not infer or manage development-stage progress.

evals.prompt: 审阅一下 Yuxi PR #123，发现问题后回复 review。
evals.expected_output: Explain that code review and publishing review responses are outside yuxi-manage. The skill may report PR, approval, and CI status, but must not inspect code for findings, publish a review, approve, request changes, or invoke an external code-review skill.
